name: Admir Serrano
abstract_title: Consciousness out of the body: My twenty-five years of spontaneous and self-induced out-of-body experiences indicate the non-locality of consciousness
abstract: Over the course of twenty-five years of sustained out-of-body experiences (OBEs), I have systematically explored the nature of consciousness through direct, repeatable personal encounters that challenge conventional neuroscientific assumptions. These experiences - voluntarily induced, spontaneous, and some verified - have provided consistent evidence that consciousness is not confined to, nor generated solely by the physical brain.
